Acceptance of Terms By accessing or using GameBuddies.io ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use the Service. 2. Service Description GameBuddies.io is a multiplayer browser game platform that connects users to play various online party games. The platform offers both free and premium features. Features may change over time, and temporary service interruptions may occur. 3. User Accounts You may use the Service as a guest or create an account. If you create an account, you are responsible for maintaining the security of your credentials. You may not share your account or use another person's account. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. 4. User Conduct When using the Service, you agree not to: Cheat, exploit bugs, or use unauthorized tools to gain unfair advantages Harass, bully, or use hate speech against other players Use the Service for any illegal purpose or to transmit harmful content Impersonate other players, moderators, or staff Attempt to disrupt the Service or its infrastructure 5. Intellectual Property & User-Generated Content All content, design, code, and branding of GameBuddies.io are the property of their respective owners. You may not copy, modify, or distribute any part of the Service without permission. User-generated content (such as custom questions, drawings, audio recordings, text answers, and other creative submissions made during gameplay) remains your intellectual property. However, by creating or submitting content through the Service, you grant GameBuddies.io a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual, irrevocable, transferable, and sub-licensable license to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, display, distribute, and create derivative works of your user-generated content for any purpose, including but not limited to operating, promoting, and improving the Service, as well as for marketing, social media, blog posts, and promotional materials. This license survives termination of your account. You represent that you own or have the necessary rights to the content you submit, and that it does not infringe on any third party's rights. We may remove any user-generated content at our sole discretion. Drawings and other creative content created during gameplay may be stored on our servers for quality assurance, platform improvement, and potential display in galleries or promotional contexts. 6. Disclaimer of Warranties The Service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uptime, data persistence, or uninterrupted gameplay. Use the Service at your own risk. 7. Limitation of Liability The operator is liable without limitation for damages caused by intent or gross negligence, as well as for injury to life, body, or health. For slight negligence, the operator is only liable in the event of a breach of a material contractual obligation (cardinal obligation), and in such cases liability is limited to the foreseeable, contract-typical damage. This does not affect liability under the German Product Liability Act (Produkthaftungsgesetz). All other liability for slight negligence is excluded. 8. Withdrawal Rights (Widerrufsbelehrung) If you are a consumer in the EU/EEA, you have the right to withdraw from a premium subscription within 14 days of purchase without giving any reason. To exercise your withdrawal right, please send a clear statement (e.g., by email) to: Sebastian Krol GameBuddies.io Email: contact@gamebuddies.io Important exception for digital content: If you have expressly consented to the immediate provision of digital content (e.g., premium features) and acknowledged that you thereby lose your right of withdrawal, the withdrawal right expires upon the start of the service. In the event of a valid withdrawal, we will reimburse all payments received from you within 14 days using the same payment method used for the original transaction. 9. Modifications We reserve the right to modify these Terms or the Service at any time. Changes to the Terms will be posted on this page. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms. 10. Governing Law These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany. Any disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts in Germany. 11. Content Moderation & Reporting Illegal Content (EU Digital Services Act) Point of contact: Our single point of contact under Articles 11 and 12 of the EU Digital Services Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/2065) — for users as well as for authorities of the EU Member States, the European Commission and the European Board for Digital Services — is contact@gamebuddies.io. You can write to us in German or English. Every message is read and answered by a person, not by an automated system. Reporting illegal content: If you come across content on GameBuddies.io that you believe is illegal — for example a player name, chat message, drawing, uploaded image or custom card — send a report to contact@gamebuddies.io. Please include: why you believe the content is illegal where exactly it is (page address, game, room code, player name and, if possible, a screenshot) your name and email address (not required for reports of child sexual abuse material) a statement that you believe in good faith that the information in your report is accurate and complete We confirm receipt, review every report carefully and objectively, and tell you what we decided and why. How we moderate: Player names, room codes, chat messages and text typed in games pass through an automatic filter that compares them with a list of offensive words. It is a fixed word list, not an AI system. If it finds a match, the text is not accepted and you see a notice in the game. Room hosts can remove players from their room. The operator reviews reports personally and may remove content, remove players from rooms, or restrict or delete accounts that break the law or these Terms. Account restrictions are always decided by a person. If we restrict your content or account: We tell you the reason and the facts behind the decision, as far as we can reach you (for registered accounts by email). You can object to any decision at contact@gamebuddies.io, and a person will review it again. Your right to take legal action is not affected. 12.
